limitations: Each cohort has one independent holdout. Its errors describe this measurement, not statistical accuracy, confidence intervals or guaranteed prediction bounds.
Source 25-row calibrations and target 73-row short calibrations cover the planned 39 updates. Target-specific setup and finalization are measured on the target dataset, not scaled by its row count.
Measured component groups require two independent processes and unchanged within-process repeat thresholds. Missing terminal gaps reject a CPU rebudget even when a longer horizon was covered.

The same-model and fixed padded width-128 cohorts exercise changing random row order, dataset sizes, masks and labels; they do not establish transfer to other models, shapes, GPUs, software versions, packing or distributed training.

HF and Factory use model seed 42 with source data_seed 42 and target data_seed 123. Axolotl 0.18.0 forwards its seed 42 but does not forward a separate YAML data_seed, so both native Axolotl datasets use seed 42.

The complete native span excludes process startup, report construction and CLI output. Net time subtracts measured observation spans, including batch input hashing, and does not remove every observer perturbation.
Empty manifests describe the five controlled input cache directories. They do not attest cache hits, external cache dependencies, OS page caches, stable GPU clocks or system load.

Allocator peak ranges come from contributing calibration processes; coverage does not prove the combined future run's peak, fragmentation or long-run memory growth. Peaks exclude non-PyTorch memory and are neither physical-card OOM tests nor minimum-VRAM estimates. This round adds no OOM control trials.

The original HF driver incorrectly assumed a shorter CPU horizon must be covered. All five native runs succeeded; the unchanged original failed summary and CPU-only supplement are retained, with no training rerun or accuracy-based refitting.

The original 68-to-84 periodic-events CPU preview missed 14 repeated trainer_other groups. The 108-to-124 specification was fixed and checked before its three GPU runs; no coverage or error thresholds were relaxed.

CPU previews use the native data pipeline and collators without GPU training. Declared CPU pin-memory/precision differences are retained; tensor order and hashes are compared without requiring CPU/GPU whole-plan hashes to be identical.

Only review records, hashes and independent weight statistics are archived. Model weights, optimizer state tensors, tokenizer exports and cache contents are excluded. Path substitutions invalidate execution-bound identities for calibration reuse.
